description: The Symantec PGP Cryptographic Engine is a FIPS 140-2 validated software only cryptographic module. The module implements the cryptographic functions for Symantec Encryption products. It includes a wide range of field-tested and standards-based encryption, digital signature, and encoding algorithms.
